files.README.md:
# pantry-infra

`nginx/nginx.conf` is deployed to /etc/nginx/nginx.conf on the edge host with `make deploy` (rsync + `nginx -t` + reload).
Certificates are managed by certbot on the host: `certbot renew --cert-name <name>`, then `nginx -s reload`.
files.Makefile:
deploy:
	rsync -av nginx/ edge:/etc/nginx/
	ssh edge 'nginx -t && nginx -s reload'
files.scripts/check-certs.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
for host in api.pantry.dev pantry.dev admin.pantry.dev; do
  echo -n "$host: "
  echo | openssl s_client -connect "$host:443" -servername "$host" 2>/dev/null | openssl x509 -noout -enddate
done
